When you start learning with me, you will know exactly what you're saying and why Hindi/Punjabi speakers speak a certain way. Basically, if you EVER have a question, you can interrupt me anytime you want, or if we're not in a lesson, you can send me a text and I will promptly reply to you!

I usually teach with analogies to any other languages you might speak, so you can understand why certain things are happening in a sentence.
